anchorBindingMethod.summary: Every capture is bound to one scene-contract syncAnchor id. ch7-reconstruct frames are bound from the standing objective recorded for that exact frame in the run trace beside it, mapped to the most recently activated anchor via the repair-stage to anchor map. ch8-launch frames are bound from the launch state visible in the frame plus the anchor activation times in evidence-hires/av-state-trace.json. Frames whose live beat carries no anchor in this contract are bound to the nearest in-scope boundary anchor and marked beat-level-approximate.

openCaptureGaps: Manual (non-movie) ch7 build-step play cannot be driven headless: the five repair transactions need real [F]/[C] interaction. Every per-step capture here is movie-mode autopilot, which compresses diagnose to flight_ready into about 4 seconds.

anc.launch.ignition was never the sole active anchor in a 200 ms sample: in movie mode ignition and liftoff are both activated by the first post-ignition sample, so cin.launch.01-engine-finds-weight has no isolated before/at/after frame.
anc.reconstruct.first-hover and cin.reconstruct.07-route-becomes-intention never activated: the first-hover rehearsal is optional exploration and did not occur in the movie path.
Reduced-motion, mobile viewport, and POTATO-tier variants were not captured in this baseline pass.
No headed / real-pointer-lock capture. Per main/src/story/ux/README.md, headless scripted input is diagnostic only and cannot stand in for continuity or taste evidence.
